_optionalServers._comment: Optional local servers — NOT enabled by default and NOT loaded from this block. backpack-trading is a local, user-side-signing Backpack trading server (testnet by default, master switch off, user-set caps required). To enable it, add a backpack-trading entry with command/args pointing at servers/backpack-trading/server.mjs and read that server's README first. Never put API keys or seeds in this file.
